campuses.title: City Centre Campus
campuses.text: Main campus in downtown Edmonton — Alberta's capital city — offering undergraduate programs in business, arts, sciences, nursing, and fine arts in a modern urban campus environment.

paragraphs: MacEwan University is a public undergraduate university in Edmonton, Alberta, offering more than 65 programs across business, arts, sciences, education, health, and fine arts. Founded in 1971, MacEwan serves approximately 19,000 students, with a growing international enrolment.

MacEwan is known for its small class sizes, student-centred approach, and strong academic programs in nursing, business, psychology, music, and social work. The university's City Centre Campus in downtown Edmonton provides a vibrant urban learning environment with easy access to the city's cultural and business scene.

International students at MacEwan benefit from dedicated international student services, English language preparation, and a welcoming community with students from over 90 countries. MacEwan's nursing and health programs have particular appeal for internationally educated health professionals seeking Canadian credentials.

Edmonton is Alberta's capital city, with a strong economy driven by energy, technology, and government sectors. International graduates are eligible for the Post-Graduation Work Permit and may access provincial nominee programs for Canadian permanent residency.

MacEwan известен небольшими классами и ориентированным на студента подходом. Особенно сильны программы Nursing, Business, Psychology, Music и Social Work.
